Parameter.Name: AIDS
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — This parameter stores numeric values with decimal precision. Source: RunSetupTbl — The value is sourced from the run setup table used for model configuration.

Parameter.Name: AccidentalMortality
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — This parameter stores a single numeric value with high decimal precision. Source: RunSetupTbl — The value is sourced from the run setup table used for model configuration.

Parameter.Name: CUDiscounting
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Stores text values, typically used to reference a discounting method or curve. Source: RunSetupTbl — The value is sourced from the run setup table.

Parameter.Name: CriticalIllness
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the critical illness benefit amount or loading applied within the product setup. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent run setup configuration table.

Parameter.Name: DecrementBasis
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the decrement assumption set used in the model run. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup table defining base decrement assumptions.

Parameter.Name: Expense
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the expense loading or rate applied in model runs. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup defining base expense assumptions.

Parameter.Name: ExpenseBasis
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the expense basis table or assumption reference used in the model. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is taken from the parent setup table linking to the expense basis configuration.

Parameter.Name: ExpenseInflation
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the inflation rate applied to expense projections. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup table used for inflation adjustments in modeling.

Parameter.Name: InflationYC
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the inflation yield curve used for economic projections. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent run setup table defining inflation curve references.

Parameter.Name: LIYCRun
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Integer — Indicates the logical run identifier for life insurance yield curve simulations. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent run setup table to control execution sequencing.

Parameter.Name: Lapses
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the lapse rate or assumption applied to policy terminations. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup defining lapse assumptions for projection runs.

Parameter.Name: MPFName
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the MPF assumption set used for model runs. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent run setup table specifying the MPF configuration name.

Parameter.Name: MorbidityCATIndicator
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Integer — Indicates whether morbidity catastrophe adjustments are active in the model. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the run setup table controlling morbidity CAT inclusion flags.

Parameter.Name: Mortality
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the mortality rate or assumption used in actuarial projections. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the parent setup table defining mortality parameters for projections.

Parameter.Name: MortalityCATIndicator
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Integer — Acts as a flag indicating the inclusion of mortality catastrophe adjustments in the model. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is sourced from the run setup configuration controlling mortality CAT indicators.

Parameter.Name: NBMarker
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Indicates the new business marker for model run identification. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the run setup table used to distinguish new business model executions.

Parameter.Name: NaturalMortality
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the natural mortality rate used in actuarial projections excluding accidental causes. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is inherited from the run setup configuration defining natural death assumptions.

Parameter.Name: NextValnDate
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Date — Specifies the date of the next valuation cycle. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is derived from the run setup table defining the timing for the subsequent valuation period.

Parameter.Name: NominalYC
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Identifies the nominal yield curve reference used in the valuation run. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is retrieved from the run setup table specifying yield curve naming conventions.

Parameter.Name: Parent
Parameter.Notes: DataType: IModel — Defines the parent model reference within the run setup configuration. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The parameter points to the primary actuarial model instance used for the current reporting run.

Parameter.Name: PermanentDisability
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the calculated rate or value associated with permanent disability events. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The parameter value is sourced from the run setup table containing core assumptions for decrement analysis.

Parameter.Name: PolicyStartLevel
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Indicates the starting policy level value used for actuarial or pricing calculations. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value originates from the run setup table storing key initialization parameters for valuation runs.

Parameter.Name: RegulatoryExpenseBasis
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Defines the regulatory expense basis applied during statutory or compliance valuation runs. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The value is derived from the run setup table storing configuration for regulatory reporting assumptions.

Parameter.Name: Retrenchment
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the retrenchment decrement rate applied in actuarial projections. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Derived from the parent run setup table storing retrenchment assumptions for modeling policy terminations.

Parameter.Name: RunOutputNextValnDate
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Date — Specifies the next valuation date for output reporting in YYYY/MM/DD format. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — The parameter is sourced from the run setup table and determines the upcoming financial or actuarial reporting cycle.

Parameter.Name: RunOutputValnDate
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Date — Represents the valuation date for model output generation. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Used as the reporting date reference for the current run of actuarial results.

Parameter.Name: RunSetupTblPrm
Parameter.Notes: DataType: TableStr — Refers to the table containing parameterized run setup configurations. Source: RunControlTbl — Used for controlling run-level settings and environment configuration across multiple simulations.

Parameter.Name: RunType
Parameter.Notes: DataType: String — Describes the type of actuarial or reporting run being performed (e.g., closing, projection, or sensitivity test). Source: prmRunSetupTbl — This identifies the specific run configuration and context for reporting.

Parameter.Name: ShockDuration
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Integer — Specifies the duration (in months or years) of applied stress or shock in scenario testing. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Used for sensitivity and resilience testing across actuarial projections.

Parameter.Name: TemporaryDisability
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Represents the temporary disability rate or assumption used in the valuation. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Defined in the run setup parameters for use in modeling temporary disability decrements.

Parameter.Name: TerminalIllness
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Double — Reflects the terminal illness rate or assumption used in actuarial modeling. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Defined in the run setup parameters to drive terminal illness decrement or claim probability calculations.

Parameter.Name: ValnDate
Parameter.Notes: DataType: Date — Represents the valuation date used for financial and actuarial reporting. Source: prmRunSetupTbl — Derived from the run setup parameters indicating the effective date for the model valuation.

Formula.Name: AccidentalDeathRIRecoveries_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.AccidentalDeathRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.AccidentalDeathFamRICover(t)

Formula.Name: AllocatedPrem_WP
Formula.Value: If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 And ValMonth(t) >= 0 And t < SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm Return OEPremium_WP(t) - PolFee_WP() End If

Formula.Name: BalDate
Formula.Value: 'Return GetBalDate(t - PeriodIF(), SMCoreModel.ValnDate, StepsPY) Return SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)

Formula.Name: BoS_WP
Formula.Value: If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 If Date.FromOADate(SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)) = DateAtMaturity() Return SMCoreModel.BoS * (OEValueBOM_WP(t) + AllocatedPrem_WP(t)) Else If Date.FromOADate(SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)) > DateAtMaturity() Return SMCoreModel.BoS * AllocatedPrem_WP(t) Else Return 0 End If End If

Formula.Name: CriticalIllessRIRecoveries_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.CriticalIllnessRICover(t)

Formula.Name: DateAtMaturity
Formula.Value: Return DateAdd("yyyy", SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm, SMCoreModel.CoverStartDate)

Formula.Name: DeathRIRecoveries_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.DeathRICover(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedAccidentalDeath_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_Fam_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedAmtInvested_WP
Formula.Value: If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 If Date.FromOADate(SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)) = DateAtMaturity() Return (ExpectedOEValueBOM_WP(t) + AllocatedPrem_WP(t) - BoS_WP(t)) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) Else If Date.FromOADate(SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)) > DateAtMaturity() Return (AllocatedPrem_WP(t) - BoS_WP(t)) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) Else Return 0 End If End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedAnnuity_WP
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() If SMCoreModel.Annuity_t_discounting = 0 If SMCoreModel.Annuity_is_contingent = 1 If SMCoreModel.Annuity_cover_trigger = SMCoreModel.Life2_death 'Annuity paid when life2 dies before t; life1 survives Return SMCoreModel.Annuity_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.tpx_tqy(t - 1) End If Else Return SMCoreModel.Annuity_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Apply_To_Annuity_PRO(t - 1) End If Else If SMCoreModel.Annuity_is_contingent = 1 If SMCoreModel.Annuity_cover_trigger = SMCoreModel.Life2_death 'Annuity paid when life2 dies before t; life1 survives Return SMCoreModel.Annuity_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.tpx_tqy(t) End If Else Return SMCoreModel.Annuity_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Apply_To_Annuity_PRO(t) End If End If Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedAquisitionAAW_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.AcquisitionAAW_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedCashbackBenefit_WP
Formula.Value:
If t = 0 Return 0 ElseIf SMCoreModel.Cashback_Amt_source = "MPF" Then
' If SMCoreModel.ProductName = "Whole of Life Enhanced - WP" And SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) = SMCoreModel.Periodic_cash_yrs Then ' Return ((SMCoreModel.Periodic_CashBack_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.DeathBonusDecl) * ((1 + DeathBonusRateFn()) ^ (ValMonth(t))) + ReturnOfPremium(t)) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) * 0 ' Else If Not (SMCoreModel.ProductName = "Whole of Life Enhanced - WP") And (SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) Mod SMCoreModel.Periodic_cash_yrs) = 0 And SMCoreModel.CoverStartDate.Month = Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)).Month Then ' Return (SMCoreModel.Periodic_CashBack_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.DeathBonusDecl) * ((1 + DeathBonusRateFn()) ^ (ValMonth(t))) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) ' End If
If (SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) Mod SMCoreModel.Periodic_cash_yrs) = 0 And SMCoreModel.CoverStartDate.Month - 1 = Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)).Month Then Return (WPCashBackSumAssured(t)) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If
End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedClaimExpPerClaim_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPerClaim_func(t) * (SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_PRO(t))

Formula.Name: ExpectedClaimPercClaimAmt_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPercClaimAmt_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedComissionClawback_WP
Formula.Value:
'If ValMonth(t) = 0 ' Return 0 'Else ' Return - 1 * SMCoreModel.Comission_Clawback_func(t) * SMCoreModel.Lapses_PRO(t) 'End If
If t <= SMCoreModel.Comm_clawback_months And t > 0 Then Return - 1 * SMCoreModel.Comission_Clawback_func(t) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedCriticalIllness_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedDeath_WP
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) <= SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If SMCoreModel.ProductName.ToUpper.Contains("BABY PRESENT") Then Return WPSurrenderSumAssured(t) * (1 - SMCoreModel.lx_Life2_PRO(t)) * SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t) Else Return WPSumAssured(t) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) End If End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedFuneral_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Funeral_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedInitExpPerPrem_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Then Return 0 Return SMCoreModel.InitialExpPercPremium_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedInitExpensePP_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.InitialExpPP_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedInitialComission_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Initial_Comission_Func(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedLumpsumDeath_WP
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) <= SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If SMCoreModel.Lumpsum_Death_is_contingent = 1 If SMCoreModel.Lumpsum_Death_cover_trigger = SMCoreModel.Life2_death 'Lumpsum paid when life2 dies at time t; life1 survives Return SMCoreModel.Lumpsum_Death_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.tpxy(t) * SMCoreModel.qy_plus_t(t) End If End If Else Return SMCoreModel.Lumpsum_Death_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedMaturity_WP
Formula.Value:
'If SMCoreModel.OpenEndIndicator = 1 And SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) = ProjTerm() ' Return OEValueEOM_WP(t) * WPMaturity_PRO(t - 1) 'ElseIf SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) = ProjTerm() - 1 Then ' Return (((WPMaturitySumAssured(t) + SMCoreModel.MaturityBonusDecl) * (1 + MaturityBonusRateFn()) ^ (ValMonth(t))) * (1 + TerminalBonusRateFn() * (SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm / 12))) * SMCoreModel.Maturity_PRO(t) 'Else ' Return 0 'End If
If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) = ProjTerm() - 1 Then If SMCoreModel.ProductName.ToUpper.Contains("BABY PRESENT") Then Return ((WPMaturitySumAssured(t)) * (1 + TerminalBonusRateFn() * (SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm / 12))) * SMCoreModel.lx_Life2_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.Maturity_PRO(t) Else Return ((WPMaturitySumAssured(t)) * (1 + TerminalBonusRateFn() * (SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm / 12))) * SMCoreModel.Maturity_PRO(t) End If Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedNaturalDeath_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_PRO(t) + SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_Fam_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedOEValueBOM_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 And Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 Return SMCoreModel.InitOEFV Else If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 Return ExpectedOEValueEOM_WP(t - 1) * SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t - 1) Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedOEValueEOM_WP
Formula.Value: If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 Then Return ExpectedOEValueBOM_WP(t) + OEPremium_WP(t) - PolFee_WP() - BoS_WP(t) + GuaranteedOEInterest_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedPPE_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Per_pol_exp_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedPaidUp_WP
Formula.Value: 'Return WPPaidUpCover(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) Return 0 * t

Formula.Name: ExpectedPartialSurrender_WP
Formula.Value: Return WPPartialSurrenderCover(t) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedPercCUExpense_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Perc_CU_exp_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedPercPremExpense_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Perc_premium_exp_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedPermanentDisability_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedPremiums_WP
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 ElseIf OEPremium_WP(t) > 0 Return - OEPremium_WP(t) Else If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) <= SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If SMCoreModel.Premium_is_contingent = 1 If SMCoreModel.PremiumWaiver_trigger = SMCoreModel.Life2_death Return - 1 * SMCoreModel.PremiumCF(t) * SMCoreModel.lx_Life2_PRO(t - 1) Else Return - 1 * SMCoreModel.PremiumCF(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If Else Return - 1 * SMCoreModel.PremiumCF(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedRIPremiums_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.RIPremium

Formula.Name: ExpectedRenewalComission_WP
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else Return SMCoreModel.Renewal_Comission_func(t) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedRetrenchment_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedShareholderBenefit
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.IsShareholderInd = 1 Return SMCoreModel.IsShareholderInd * (WPSumAssured(t) - SMCoreModel.DeathCoverAmt + (ExpectedMaturity_WP(t) / SMCoreModel.Maturity_PRO(t - 1)) - SMCoreModel.DeathCoverAmt) * SMCoreModel.Shareholder_perc_decl_bonus * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: ExpectedSurrender_WP
Formula.Value: Return WPSurrenderSumAssured(t) * SMCoreModel.Surrenders_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedTemporaryDisability_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedTerminalIllness_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_cover(t) * SMCoreModel.Accidental_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: ExpectedWOP_WP
Formula.Notes: Waiver of premium benefit upon death of premium payer
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) <= SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm If SMCoreModel.Premium_is_contingent = 1 If SMCoreModel.PremiumWaiver_trigger = SMCoreModel.Life2_death Return SMCoreModel.PremiumCF(t) * SMCoreModel.lx_Life2_PRO(t - 1) 'WOP is life 2 dies Else If SMCoreModel.PremiumWaiver_trigger = "MainDeath" Then Return SMCoreModel.PremiumCF(t) * SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) 'WOP is Main life dies End If Else Return 0 End If End If

Formula.Name: FuneralRIRecoveries_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.FuneralRICover(t)

Formula.Name: FutureBonusRateFn
Formula.Value:
If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.MPF Return (1 + SMCoreModel.DeathBonusPerc) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 Else If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Return SMCoreModel.Future_bonus End If
'If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.MPF ' Return (1 + SMCoreModel.DeathBonusPerc) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 'Else If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate ' Return (1 + SMCoreModel.Death_bonus) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 'End If

Formula.Name: Future_Reversionary_Bonus_CashBackCover
Formula.Value:
Dim Benefit As Double
If SMCoreModel.WithProfit_Ind <> "With Profits" Then Return 0
If t > ProjTerm() Or Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)) > SMCoreModel.CoverEndDate Then Return 0 End If
If t = 0 Then Return 0 End If
Benefit = SMCoreModel.Periodic_CashBack_cover(t)
'Past reversionary bonus only, before valuation date If ValMonth(t) >= 0 And SMCoreModel.BenefitEscMonthInd(t) = 1 Then
' Return Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t - 1) _ ' + Benefit * FutureBonusRateFn() Return Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t - 1) _ + (Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t - 1) + Benefit) * FutureBonusRateFn()
Else Return Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t - 1) End If

Formula.Name: Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover
Formula.Value:
Dim Benefit As Double
If SMCoreModel.WithProfit_Ind <> "With Profits" Then Return 0
If t > ProjTerm() Or Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)) > SMCoreModel.CoverEndDate Then Return 0 End If
If t = 0 Then Return 0 End If
If SMCoreModel.PolicyStatus = "Paid Up" Then Benefit = SMCoreModel.PaidUp_cover(t) Else Benefit = SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) End If
'Past reversionary bonus only, before valuation date If ValMonth(t) >= 0 And SMCoreModel.BenefitEscMonthInd(t) = 1 Then
' Return Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t - 1) _ ' + Benefit * FutureBonusRateFn() Return Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t - 1) _ + (Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t - 1) + Benefit) * FutureBonusRateFn()
Else Return Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t - 1) End If

Formula.Name: GuaranteedGthPCMth_WP
Formula.Value: Return (1 + SMCoreModel.Guaranteed_unit_growth_perc) ^ (1 / 12) - 1

Formula.Name: GuaranteedOEInterest_WP
Formula.Value: If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 Return (GuaranteedGthPCMth_WP()) * (OEValueBOM_WP(t) + OEPremium_WP(t) - PolFee_WP() - BoS_WP(t)) End If

Formula.Name: HealthyPROBOM_WP
Formula.Value:
If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) = 0 Return 1 End If
If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) <= ProjTerm() And SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) > 0 If SMCoreModel.OpenEndIndicator = 1 Return HealthyPROBOM_WP(t - 1) - SMCoreModel.Mortality_PRO(t) Else Return SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t - 1) End If End If

Formula.Name: InflationEscalation
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.InflationRateFn(t)

Formula.Name: MaturityBonusRateFn
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.MPF Return (1 + SMCoreModel.MaturityBonusPerc) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 Else If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Return SMCoreModel.Maturity_bonus End If ' 'If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.MPF ' Return (1 + SMCoreModel.MaturityBonusPerc) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 'Else If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate ' Return (1 + SMCoreModel.Maturity_bonus) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 'End If

Formula.Name: Max_OE_End_Date
Formula.Value: Return DateAdd("yyyy", Max_OE_Term(), DateAtMaturity())

Formula.Name: Max_OE_Term
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Max_OE_Term

Formula.Name: NaturalDeathRIRecoveries_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.NaturalDeathRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.Natural_Mortality_Fam_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.NaturalDeathFamRICover(t)

Formula.Name: NomEscalation
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return (1 + Economic_curves.Value(Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)), SMCoreModel.Nom_input()) - SMCoreModel.Investment_expense_perc + SMCoreModel.Int_margin_ind * SMCoreModel.Int_margin_val) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 End If

Formula.Name: OEPremium_WP
Formula.Value:
If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) <= SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm Return (SMCoreModel.OEAnnualPrem / 12) * HealthyPROBOM_WP(t) End If
'Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1

Formula.Name: OEValueBOM_WP
Formula.Value:
If t > ProjTerm() Return 0 End If
If ValMonth(t) = 0 And Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 Return SMCoreModel.InitOEFV Else If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 Return OEValueEOM_WP(t - 1) Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: OEValueEOM_WP
Formula.Value: If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 Then Return OEValueBOM_WP(t) + OEPremium_WP(t) - PolFee_WP() - BoS_WP(t) + GuaranteedOEInterest_WP(t) - ExpectedPartialSurrender_WP(t) End If '

Formula.Name: PeriodIF
Formula.Value: 'Return DateSpan.TermInMonths(SMCoreModel.CoverStartDate, SMCoreModel.ValuationDate) Return SMCoreModel.PeriodIF()

Formula.Name: PermanentDisRIRecoveries_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.PermanentDisabilityRICover(t)

Formula.Name: PolFeeInfl_WP
Formula.Value: If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 If SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Then Return (1 + SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 ElseIf SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl_source = SMCoreModel.Yield_curve Then Return InflationEscalation(t) Else Return 0 End If End If

Formula.Name: PolFee_WP
Formula.Value:
Return 0 'Assume fee income deducted offsets expense, so no impact on total reserves
'Dim z As Double 'If Within_OE_Period_ind(t) = 1 ' ' ' If SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Then ' If Month(Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t))) = Month(SMCoreModel.CoverStartDate) Then ' z = (SMCoreModel.Policy_fee_amt / 12) * (1 + PolFeeInfl_WP(t)) ^ (12 * SMCoreModel.pol_year(t)) ' End If ' ElseIf SMCoreModel.Pol_chge_infl_source = SMCoreModel.Yield_curve Then ' z = (SMCoreModel.Policy_fee_amt / 12) * (1 + PolFeeInfl_WP(t)) ^ 1 ' ElseIf SMCoreModel.Policy_fee_amt > 0 ' z = (SMCoreModel.Policy_fee_amt / 12) ' Else ' ' z = PolFee_WP(t - 1) ' End If 'End If ' 'Return z

Formula.Name: ProjTerm
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.ProjTerm

Formula.Name: RetrenchmentRIRecoveries_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.RetrenchmentRICover(t)

Formula.Name: ReturnOfPremium
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 ElseIf SMCoreModel.Cashback_Amt_source = "MPF" Then If SMCoreModel.ProductName = "Whole of Life Enhanced - WP" And SMCoreModel.PolYear(t) = SMCoreModel.Periodic_cash_yrs Then Return (SMCoreModel.PremiumCF(t) * 12 * 15) End If End If

Formula.Name: TemporaryDisabilityRIRecoveries_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.TemporaryDisabilityRICover(t)

Formula.Name: TerminalBonusRateFn
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.MPF Return SMCoreModel.TerminalBonusPerc Else If SMCoreModel.Bonus_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Return SMCoreModel.Terminal_bonus End If

Formula.Name: TerminalIllnessRIRecoveries_WP
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_PRO(t) * SMCoreModel.TerminalIllnessRICover(t)

Formula.Name: Total_Reversionary_Bonus_CashBackCover
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Past_Reversionary_Bonus_CashBackCover(t) + Future_Reversionary_Bonus_CashBackCover(t)

Formula.Name: Total_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Past_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t) + Future_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t)

Formula.Name: ValMonth
Formula.Value: Return t - PeriodIF()

Formula.Name: WPCashBackSumAssured
Formula.Value:
'If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) <= SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm ' If SMCoreModel.PolicyStatus = "Paid Up" ' Return (SMCoreModel.PaidUp_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.DeathBonusDecl) ' Else ' Return (SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.DeathBonusDecl) * ((1 + DeathBonusRateFn()) ^ (ValMonth(t))) ' End If 'End If
Return (SMCoreModel.Periodic_CashBack_cover(t) + Total_Reversionary_Bonus_CashBackCover(t))

Formula.Name: WPCover
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.OpenEndIndicator = 1 Return OEValueBOM_WP(t) Else If SMCoreModel.PolicyStatus = "Paid Up" Return SMCoreModel.PaidUp_cover(t) Else Return SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) End If End If

Formula.Name: WPMaturitySumAssured
Formula.Value:
If SMCoreModel.Maturity_cover_ind = 0 Then Return 0 End If ' 'If SMCoreModel.PolicyStatus = "Paid Up" ' Return SMCoreModel.PaidUp_cover(t) 'Else ' Return SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) 'End If
Return (WPCover(t) + Total_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t))

Formula.Name: WPMaturity_PRO
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) = ProjTerm() - 1 Return 1 End If

Formula.Name: WPPaidUpCover
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.PaidUp_cover(t)

Formula.Name: WPPartialSurrenderCover
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.OpenEndIndicator = 1 Return OEValueBOM_WP(t) Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: WPSumAssured
Formula.Value:
'If SMCoreModel.DurIF(t) <= SMCoreModel.PolicyTerm ' If SMCoreModel.PolicyStatus = "Paid Up" ' Return (SMCoreModel.PaidUp_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.DeathBonusDecl) ' Else ' Return (SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.DeathBonusDecl) * ((1 + DeathBonusRateFn()) ^ (ValMonth(t))) ' End If 'End If
Return (WPCover(t) + Total_Reversionary_Bonus_Cover(t))

Formula.Name: WPSurrenderSumAssured
Formula.Value:
'If SMCoreModel.PolicyStatus = "Paid Up" ' Return (SMCoreModel.Surrender_cover_factor(t) * SMCoreModel.PaidUp_cover(t)) * ((1 + DeathBonusRateFn()) ^ (ValMonth(t))) 'Else ' Return (SMCoreModel.Surrender_cover_factor(t) * SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t)) * ((1 + DeathBonusRateFn()) ^ (ValMonth(t))) 'End If If SMCoreModel.Surrender_cover_ind = 0 Then Return 0 End If
Return SMCoreModel.Surrender_cover_factor(t) * (WPSumAssured(t))

Formula.Name: Within_OE_Period_ind
Formula.Value: If SMCoreModel.OpenEndIndicator = 1 And Date.FromOADate(SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)) <= Max_OE_End_Date() Return 1 Else Return 0 End If
